title: Oridonin ameliorates doxorubicin induced-cardiotoxicity via the E2F1/Sirt6/PGC1alpha pathway in mice.
authors: Yu, Dongsheng; Li, Jiye; Wang, Yu; Guo, Danfeng; Zhu, Chunsheng; Sun, Bao; Zhou, Zheng
journal: Food and chemical toxicology : an international journal published for the British Industrial Biological Research Association
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Oridonin通过E2F1/Sirt6/PGC1alpha通路缓解阿霉素心脏毒性，仅含E2F1分子对接，非TF-DNA互作核心，方法简单且对象为药物-蛋白，与课题关联弱。
abstract: Doxorubicin induced cardiotoxicity (DIC) arises from mitochondrial dysfunction and oxidative stress. Oridonin (Ori), a natural tetracycline diterpenoid, has shown cardiac protective effect; however, its role in DIC remains unclear. This study investigates the protective effect of Ori against DIC and elucidates its underlying molecular mechanisms. The results demonstrate that Ori significantly alleviated DIC by improving myocardial structure, reducing the proportion of apoptotic cells, and alleviating the myocardial oxidative damage and mitochondrial dysfunction both in vivo and in vitro. Doxorubicin significantly decreased Sirt6 and PGC1alpha levels in cardiac tissues, which was reversed by Ori. Furthermore, Sirt6 overexpression significantly improved myocardial structure and reduced the proportion of apoptotic cells by reducing oxidative stress and improving mitochondrial function. The protective effect of Ori is neutralized by the Sirt6 inhibitor OSS_128167, evidenced by downregulated mRNA and protein expression of PGC1alpha. The transcription factor E2F1 was upregulated by doxorubicin, leading to decreased Sirt6 expression-an effect mitigated by Ori. Molecular docking simulations indicate direct binding between Ori and specific amino acid residues on E2F1 through hydroxyl bonds. These findings uncover a novel mechanism whereby Ori attenuates DIC by modulating the E2F1/Sirt6/PGC1alpha pathway.
abstract_zh: 阿霉素诱导的心脏毒性（DIC）源于线粒体功能障碍和氧化应激。冬凌草甲素（Ori），一种天然四环二萜类化合物，已显示出心脏保护作用；然而，其在DIC中的作用仍不清楚。本研究探讨了Ori对DIC的保护作用，并阐明其潜在的分子机制。结果表明，Ori通过改善心肌结构、减少凋亡细胞比例、减轻心肌氧化损伤和线粒体功能障碍，在体内和体外均显著缓解了DIC。阿霉素显著降低了心脏组织中Sirt6和PGC1alpha的水平，而Ori逆转了这一效应。此外，Sirt6过表达通过减少氧化应激和改善线粒体功能，显著改善了心肌结构并降低了凋亡细胞比例。Ori的保护作用被Sirt6抑制剂OSS_128167中和，表现为PGC1alpha的mRNA和蛋白表达下调。转录因子E2F1被阿霉素上调，导致Sirt6表达降低——这一效应被Ori缓解。分子对接模拟表明，Ori与E2F1上的特定氨基酸残基通过羟基键直接结合。这些发现揭示了一种新机制，即Ori通过调节E2F1/Sirt6/PGC1alpha通路来减轻DIC。
